The collection

The Business Playbook Series

Practical frameworks for business improvement. Each playbook examines a distinct business challenge, helping owners and teams investigate what is happening and decide where to focus.

A suggested path

Recommended
reading order.

Follow the sequence or choose the title closest to the question you are working on.

  1. 01
    The Customer Friction Playbook ↗

    Find where effort, uncertainty or delay gets in the way of your customers, then decide which barriers deserve attention first.

  2. 02
    The Missed Revenue Playbook ↗

    Examine opportunities within your existing business and evaluate what may be recoverable, what it would cost to act and what evidence would demonstrate a worthwhile result.
